LanguageData.Gun_SA_vz58P_RWP.description: The SA vz. 58 P is a rugged, semi-automatic rifle known for its reliability and lightweight design. Originally developed in Czechoslovakia, it features a distinctive short-stroke gas piston system, providing impressive accuracy and rapid follow-up shots. Ideal for tribes needing a balance between firepower and maneuverability.
